name: WARNING: Traditional Deep-Fried Churros with Cinnamon Sugar
whyItWorks: Extruded choux pastry deep-fried in commercial fryer oil and rolled in granulated cinnamon sugar, often filled with dulce de leche. Deep frying fats combined with refined sugar crystals cause rapid postprandial cramping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip churros. Order warm agua de horchata or corn tortillas with a touch of honey.
